{
  "name": "pi-bifrost",
  "version": "0.5.0",
  "description": "Route Pi turns through models you choose, with configured tiers and opt-in per-request dispatch.",
  "files": [
    "*.ts",
    "dist/router/",
    "bifrost.json",
    "schema.json",
    "examples/",
    "skills/configure-bifrost/",
    "docs/router-api.md",
    "CHANGELOG.md"
  ],
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    "./router": {
      "types": "./dist/router/router.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/router/router.js"
    },
    "./*": "./*"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "author": {
    "name": "Aamir",
    "url": "https://github.com/iamaamir"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/iamaamir/pi-bifrost.git"
  },
  "homepage": "https://iamaamir.github.io/pi-bifrost/",
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/iamaamir/pi-bifrost/issues"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "pi-package",
    "pi-extension",
    "model-router",
    "model-routing",
    "developer-tools",
    "llm",
    "ai",
    "coding-agent"
  ],
  "pi": {
    "extensions": [
      "./index.ts"
    ],
    "skills": [
      "./skills/configure-bifrost"
    ],
    "minPiVersion": "1.0.1",
    "image": "https://iamaamir.github.io/pi-bifrost/social-card.png"
  },
  "crap": {
    "threshold": 30,
    "coverage": "coverage/coverage-final.json",
    "history": "docs/quality/crap-history.jsonl"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build:router": "node scripts/build-router.mjs",
    "prepack": "npm run build:router",
    "test": "node --test --experimental-strip-types \"tests/*.test.ts\" \"tests/*.test.mjs\"",
    "test:coverage": "c8 --reporter=json --reporter=text node --test --experimental-strip-types \"tests/*.test.ts\" \"tests/*.test.mjs\"",
    "crap": "npm run test:coverage && node scripts/crap-report.mjs",
    "crap:record": "npm run test:coverage && node scripts/crap-report.mjs --record",
    "crap:trend": "node scripts/crap-report.mjs --trend",
    "test:mutation": "stryker run",
    "test:integration": "node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/integration/*.test.mjs",
    "test:ui": "python3 scripts/ui-smoke.py",
    "test:ui:agent-tui": "bash scripts/ui-smoke-agent-tui.sh",
    "test:ui:reliability": "bash scripts/ui-reliability-fake-provider.sh",
    "verify:release": "node scripts/verify-release.mjs",
    "check:issue-refs": "node scripts/check-issue-refs.mjs",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "tsc --noEmit",
    "benchmark:jev": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/jev-benchmark.ts",
    "release": "node --experimental-strip-types scripts/release.mjs",
    "acceptance": "node scripts/acceptance.mjs",
    "acceptance:deterministic": "node scripts/acceptance-deterministic.mjs",
    "acceptance:verify": "node scripts/verify-release.mjs",
    "evidence:pre-push": "node scripts/acceptance/evidence-rebind.mjs --pre-push",
    "check:arch": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs arch",
    "check:dead-code": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs dead-code",
    "check:ast": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs ast",
    "ast:scan": "ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml",
    "ast:test": "ast-grep test --skip-snapshot-tests",
    "check:actions": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs actions",
    "check:sast": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs sast",
    "check:secrets": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs secrets",
    "check:secrets:history": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs secrets-history",
    "check:deps": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs deps",
    "toolbox:doctor": "node scripts/toolbox.mjs doctor",
    "bench": "node scripts/bench.mjs route",
    "bench:projection": "node scripts/bench.mjs projection",
    "profile:cpu": "node scripts/profile.mjs cpu",
    "profile:heap": "node scripts/profile.mjs heap"
  },
  "peerDependencies": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "*",
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "*",
    "@earendil-works/pi-tui": "*"
  },
  "peerDependenciesMeta": {
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": {
      "optional": true
    },
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": {
      "optional": true
    },
    "@earendil-works/pi-tui": {
      "optional": true
    }
  },
  "overrides": {
    "typed-rest-client": {
      "qs": "6.16.1"
    },
    "undici": "^8.12.2",
    "test-exclude": {
      "glob": "14.0.4"
    }
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@ast-grep/cli": "^0.51.0",
    "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "1.4.0",
    "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent": "1.4.0",
    "@earendil-works/pi-tui": "1.4.0",
    "@stryker-mutator/core": "^10.0.0",
    "@types/node": "^26.1.1",
    "agent-tui": "^1.1.0",
    "c8": "^12.0.0",
    "dependency-cruiser": "^18.7.0",
    "fast-check": "4.10.2",
    "knip": "^6.42.1",
    "typebox": "1.3.27",
    "typescript": "6.0.3"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "ajv": "^8.20.0"
  }
}
